held:
Your content ({size} bytes, {lines} lines) is held at {path} as held id {id}. Do not write it again.
To finish: write {call}
held_partial:
Your call was cut off before its content ended. The {size} bytes ({lines} lines) that arrived are held at {path} as held id {id}; they end with {last_line}. Do not write those again.
To finish: write {call}, where content is only the rest, continuing from the last held byte.
orientation_you: You: agent {agent}, model {model}; cwd {cwd}; no jail.
orientation_you_jailed: You: agent {agent}, model {model}; cwd {cwd}; jail root {root} (writable: {writable}).
orientation_target_refused: Target {target}: outside what the jail lets you write.
error_no_such_held_content: no held content {id} in this session
write_error_content_required: ERROR: content or from_held is required
write_error_content_with_from_held: ERROR: content and from_held together need append=true, which adds content after the held text
tools_from_held: A held id (h3) from a failed write's ERROR: write the held content instead of sending it again. With append=true, content is added after it.
tools_append: Add content to the end of the file instead of replacing it. With from_held, content is added after the held text and the result written whole.
